rows.name: Lacken
rows.note: Lacken is already mapped to Sorrel Hill. The guide also describes Black Hill and a training slope; these are not additional existing rose associations.

rows.name: Lough Bray
rows.note: One existing guide serves both catalogue variants.

rows.name: Sugar Loaf / Great Sugar Loaf (west)
rows.note: The existing guide covers the west shoulder described in the PDF.

rows.name: WCP / Westerly Car Park
rows.status: Missing guide; no confirmed separate rose
rows.note: A distinct western take-off described in the PDF. Do not automatically attach it to Mount Leinster N.

rows.name: Black Banks
rows.status: Missing guide; no confirmed separate rose
rows.note: Northern/NW take-off. Existing Mount Leinster N has a different position and sector; association requires confirmation.

rows.name: Slevebawn / Nine Stones Ridge
rows.status: Missing guide; no confirmed separate rose
rows.note: Northern/NE take-off, separate from Black Banks. Existing Mount Leinster N cannot be assigned solely by proximity.

rows.name: Mast
rows.note: The summit/mast description corresponds to the Mount Leinster area; preserve the existing rose coordinates.

rows.name: Croagh Patrick
rows.note: The guide describes north, south and west approaches. These must remain distinct point roles/launches rather than replacing all catalogue coordinates with one point. Actual description is on page 8; the contents page says 7.

point.role: parking; take-off just over the wall

rows.name: Maumturks
rows.note: The guide describes the Binn Chaonaigh launch via Maumean in Inagh Valley; not all other mountains in the Maumturks range.

rows.name: Minaun Heights
rows.note: Direct name and ridge match; the text also describes the west cliffs.

rows.name: Minaun - Lower Cliffs
rows.note: Keel Bay is nearby, but the PDF point is parking and the names/required sectors differ. Do not equate them by proximity.

rows.name: Keel West / Lough Accorrymore
rows.note: Distinct easterly launch above Lough Accorrymore. It is not the existing Keel Bay site.

rows.name: Knockmore
rows.note: Knockmore shares a paragraph with Atlantic Drive. Its printed coordinates duplicate Keel West to rounding precision and contradict the separate map label. Verify before any location import.

rows.name: Atlantic Drive
rows.note: A SW-facing series of outcrops described together with Knockmore. The PDF reference point differs from the existing rose; keep existing coordinates until locally checked.

rows.name: Rossbeigh
rows.note: Name variant Rossbehy. The guide describes top/bottom launches, parking and a bottom landing field; dunes are mentioned as an additional option.
